_comment: Copy to pricing-overrides.json and fill in. Anything omitted stays unpriced,
which means it is shown as excluded and flagged rather than counted as zero.
hcpControlPlanePerHour: the ARO HCP per-cluster control-plane fee. Microsoft has
NOT published this - it is absent from both the pricing page and the Retail
Prices API. Whatever you put here is an assumption, and the estimate labels it
as one. 0.25 is the published ROSA HCP cluster fee, used as a stand-in.
hcpControlPlaneNote: explains where the figure came from. Shown verbatim in the
estimate, so write it for whoever reads the number, not for yourself.
osDiskPerGiBMonth: managed disk price per GiB per month for your chosen tier.
sharedClusterPerVcpuHour: your internal chargeback rate for a vCPU-hour on an
existing shared cluster. This is an ALLOCATION of a cost already being paid, not
a price Azure charges. Leave null and the option shows as Unpriced.
onPremPerVcpuHour: fully-loaded on-premises cost per vCPU-hour - amortised
hardware, power, cooling, OpenShift subscription, staff. No API provides this.
hcpControlPlaneNote: Borrowed from the published ROSA HCP cluster fee ($0.25/hr) as a demo stand-in. Microsoft has not published an ARO HCP equivalent and has not confirmed parity.
